name: Ability Tower
desc:
🎲 EVERY 5 MINUTES, A NEW ABILITY CHOSEN BY FATE.

Welcome to Ability Tower! 

⚡ HOW TO PLAY:
1. Wait for the countdown—every 5 minutes, you are randomly granted a powerful new Ability!
2. Have Fun (That's the important part!)

🔥 FEATURES:
• 🔮 SECRET UNLOCKS: Think you're clever? Discover hidden secrets and complete trials to unlock exclusive, PERMANENT abilities that you keep forever!
• Full Data Saving! Your rolled Ability save automatically on death and when you leave.
• Endless Chaos—expect the unexpected and watch funny moments unfold!
